name: Deep Dot Files — 3 videos a day (PC)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'kokoro', input: $json.voiceover, voice: $('Config').first().json.KOKORO_VOICE, speed: Number($('Config').first().json.KOKORO_SPEED) || 0.9, response_format: 'wav', stream: false }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: 'Narrate this like a calm mystery documentary narrator: warm, low and intriguing, at a slow, unhurried pace with natural pauses between sentences, every word easy to follow:\n\n' + $json.voiceover }] }], generationConfig: { responseModalities: ['AUDIO'], speechConfig: { voiceConfig: { prebuiltVoiceConfig: { voiceName: $('Config').first().json.TTS_VOICE } } } } }) }}

parameters.command: ={{ $('Render Jobs').all().map(j => `if sh /files/work/render_${j.json.k}.sh ${j.json.videoFile} > /files/work/log_${j.json.k}.txt 2>&1; then echo DONE ${j.json.k} $(stat -c %s /files/out/${j.json.videoFile}); else echo FAIL ${j.json.k}; tail -n 5 /files/work/log_${j.json.k}.txt; fi`).join('\n') }}

parameters.url: ={{ $('IG: Create Reel Container').item.json.uri || ('https://rupload.facebook.com/ig-api-upload/v26.0/' + $('IG: Create Reel Container').item.json.id) }}

parameters.content:
## Deep Dot Files — 3 videos a day, runs on your PC
Gemini picks 3 real mysteries/discoveries (nature, technology, space, ocean) and writes + voices one 30-second script each, Pixabay supplies stock clips, ffmpeg edits 3 rich videos (title reveal, transitions, camera motion, particles, sound effects, branded outro), and each is posted to YouTube, Instagram and Facebook.

**Credentials**
- **Header Auth "Gemini"** → `x-goog-api-key` (*Write Scripts* + *Voiceover*)
- **Query Auth "Pixabay"** → `key` (*Find Clips*)
- **Query Auth "Meta token"** → `access_token` (IG Create/Publish, FB Start/Publish)
- **Header Auth "Meta OAuth"** → `Authorization` = `OAuth <token>` (IG/FB Upload Video)
- **YouTube OAuth2** (Upload to YouTube Shorts)

**Test without posting:** open **Video Ready** → *Execute step*. Videos appear in News\metro-n8n\files\out.
**Rebrand:** change CHANNEL_NAME in Config and put a new logo.png (square) in News\metro-n8n\files\assets.
**Speed:** PIPER_SPEED in Config (higher = slower, 1.45 default).
**Voice:** VOICE_ENGINE in Config = kokoro (default, free, exact caption timing) | gemini (enable the Gemini TTS node first) | piper. Backups are used automatically. Old note: Gemini first; if Google is busy/out of quota the local Piper voice is used automatically. To always use Piper, deactivate *Voiceover (Gemini TTS)* (select it, press D).
**Music:** any .m4a/.mp3/.wav in News\metro-n8n\files\music is picked at random.
**Go live:** click **Publish**. Your PC + Docker Desktop must be on at 6 PM.
